dct_title_s: Germany : German Confederation Boundary Lines, 1826, German Historical GIS
dct_creator_sm: IEG-Maps / Berlin Data Pool (Andreas Kunz, Robert Moeschl)
Institut fur Europaische Geschichte (Mainz, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany)
dct_description_sm: These lines represent the boundary of the German Confederation (Deutscher Bund) in 1826. The confederation boundary extends beyond 'core Germany' and includes portions of the Habsburg Empire and Luxembourg. Missing segments indicate bodies water (Lake Constance) in which boundaries were not fixed at the time or which did not connect to 'core Germany' (Adriatic Sea). The small territory in Oldenburg has become part of the Federation.
